_comment: Copy this file somewhere local and private, then run: chmod 600 <file>
Do NOT commit a filled-in copy. Add it to .gitignore.
Each customer needs name, tenantId and clientId.
The credential is supplied one of these ways, in order of preference:
certificateThumbprint            certificate in the CurrentUser store - key stays in the OS keystore
certificatePath + certificatePassword   PFX file, for hosts without a store
clientSecret                     inline - readable by any process running as you
Defining a certificate wins over clientSecret/secretVault for that customer; the script
clears $ClientSecret when it does, so a leftover secret cannot shadow the certificate.
assignmentGroupId, appOwner and descriptionsPath are optional.
pilotGroupId + productionGroupId turn on the two-ring rollout instead of a single group;
set both or neither. assignmentGroupId and the ring pair are mutually exclusive.
A value left out is treated as 'not set for this customer' rather than inherited from the
environment or from a previously selected customer.
An explicitly passed parameter still wins over the file.
